title: Additional security under clause 4.20 — writ dismissed by reference
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ petition dismissed; reasons as in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016 of even date.
headnote: Challenge to additional security demanded under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Interim restraint granted in 2014 on the strength of a similar stay; the writ was dismissed in 2017 by adopting the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
facts: M/s Kumar Casting Pvt. Limited, an industrial consumer, challenged U.P. Power Corporation Ltd.'s demand notice for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. It pointed to a 7 October 2009 interim stay in a similar petition by M/s Supreme Ceramics Ltd. On 1 May 2014 the Court connected the matter with WP(C) 51884 of 2009 and stayed the additional-security demand. A Chief Justice's Bench later dismissed the petition on 21 March 2017.

holding_units.holding: The writ challenging the licensee's demand for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, is dismissed; the Court adopts the reasons in the order of even date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
